entities.summary: Shunji Iwai (b. 1963-01-24, Sendai) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sendai and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
